paper_id: EvEval_ A Comprehensive Evaluation of Event Semantics for Large Language Models
title: EVEVAL: A Comprehensive Evaluation of Event Semantics for Large Language Models
motivation: LLM处理事件语义的能力尚不明确，且缺乏综合评估框架
problem_framing: 将事件语义处理定义为理解、推理、预测三个层次并设计8个数据集的基准测试
key_insight: 结构化事件表示（如JSON）与自然语言表现相当，为具身AI提供启示
method_signature: 构建EVEVAL基准，覆盖理解/推理/预测/CoT/表示五个维度
evaluation_criteria: 准确率/BLEU/ROUGE指标评估LLM零样本和微调性能
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: CoT对事件语义处理几乎无提升甚至降低性能
evidence_for_taste: LLMs understand individual events, but not the semantic similarity
most of the tasks would drop if adding CoT prompting
inter-event semantics is hard to learn
event causality semantics may be easier to learn and more determined
thinking_moves: 将事件语义处理系统化为理解-推理-预测三层能力体系
从零样本基准测试角度探测LLM的能力边界而非刷SOTA
承认CoT失效并追问其对事件处理无效的深层原因
